en.shaykh-tahir-ridha-jaffer: 4.Al-Naḍr ibn Suwayd narrated from al-Ḥasan ibn Mūsā, and al- Ḥasan ibn Riʾāb from Zurārah who said, “
I heard Abā Jaʿfar (a) say, ‘The background of a person is his religion, his status is his character, and his nobility is his Godwariness; verily all people are from Ādam, with the same origin.’”
